note: Hand-written for the Google Drive API v3 files.get call with alt=media, which returns the file content rather than a File resource. The runtime bridge maps gdrive.read_file onto the same workspace_read client method as gdrive.workspace_read, so this replays the same request with a different body: a file whose content is itself a JSON document, as an agent reading a .json file from a picked folder gets. It has to come back verbatim, not be decoded as a Drive resource, and the trailing newline has to survive. Not a recording.
